Name: Simple NPC Paths
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#D8B4FE][b]👣 Simple NPC Paths[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]PC · Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ · SMAPI 4.4.0+[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]See known NPC walking routes before placing objects where villagers may walk.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]👣 Spot Known Routes[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Hold a placeable chest, machine, fence or furniture item to highlight recorded walking routes. Point the placement preview at a route to see the NPC names. Multi-tile furniture checks its full footprint.

The mod [b]warns[/b] about routes; it does not block placement or change NPC movement.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]⚙ Automatic or Shortcut Control[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Automatic display while placing is On by default. Assign a keyboard or controller shortcut in optional [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b], or edit config.json while the game is closed. No shortcut is assigned by default.

The shortcut can show routes with empty hands and overrides automatic display until settings are saved or you return to the title screen. Turn off [b]Show automatically while placing[/b] for shortcut-only control. Settings also cover opacity, remembered routes and enabling the mod.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#D8B4FE][b]🗺 What the Overlay Covers[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Routes come from the game’s actual schedule pathfinding, including custom NPCs that use that system. [b]Remember previous days[/b] adds earlier recorded routes; turn it off for today’s routes only.

[b]Unmarked tiles are not guaranteed safe.[/b] Other days and seasons can use different routes. Scripted events, festivals, random wandering and mods that bypass normal schedule pathfinding are outside the overlay’s coverage. Menus and events hide it.

After a map or schedule change, the host can run [b]simplepaths_clear[/b] to forget recorded history.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#86EFAC][b]📦 Install and Multiplayer[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+[/b] and [b]SMAPI 4.4.0+[/b]. Install [b]SimpleNpcPaths[/b] in Mods and launch through SMAPI. GMCM is optional; the included mod text is English.

In multiplayer, install on the host and each player who wants the overlay. The host shares calculated route information. To uninstall, remove the mod folder while the game is closed; no placed items or NPC schedules depend on it.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#67E8F9]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a report or suggestion on this mod's page.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]For bug reports, please include:[/color][/b]
[color=#E5E7EB]• Mod version, game/SMAPI version and platform.
• What happened, what you expected and steps to reproduce it.
• A [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log link[/url], if applicable.
• A screenshot or short video, if helpful.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#86EFAC]For suggestions:[/color][/b]
[color=#E5E7EB]Tell me what you would like added or changed and how it would improve the mod.[/color][/size][/center]
